what: Hovering a color label button (corner 4px) lifts an inverted panel (white background·accent-color text) hidden below up one cell in .2s to cover it, and the text inside settles from .44em above into place. The text of the front panel exits 1.98em upward fading to .4, and the button corners round into a pill — curve cubic-bezier(0,.04,0,1)

options.--fx-usl-bg · --fx-usl-ink: Front panel background and text (css variables), default var(--kf-accent) · var(--kf-on-accent)
options.--fx-usl-bg2 · --fx-usl-ink2: Back panel background and text, default var(--kf-surface) · var(--kf-accent)
options.--fx-usl-h · --fx-usl-pad: Button height · inner panel padding, default 2.2em · 0 1.2em

use: Menu 1 — The part splits the text into two layers (by hand, [data-fx-part=a]·[data-fx-part=b] is set up, it is used as is)

from.where: shared.css .ld-pill (original .o-anim-sb — header pill menu · menu drawer SNS · footer SNS buttons. Blue panel→white panel, dark blue inside the drawer, dark orange in the footer)
